description: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance of two methods—RECA (light pink) and an unnamed method (orange)—across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, ranging from 0 to 1 in increments of 0.1, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data by frequency level. For the High frequency group, RECA achieves a score of 0.837 and the orange method scores 0.877. In the Medium frequency group, RECA scores 0.538 and the orange method scores 0.609. For the Low frequency group, RECA scores 0.114 and the orange method scores 0.224. The orange bars consistently outperform the RECA bars across all frequency levels, with the largest performance gap observed in the Low frequency category. The legend at the bottom identifies the light pink bar as RECA and the orange bar as the other method, though the latter’s label is obscured in the image. The chart visually emphasizes the declining performance of both methods as frequency decreases, with the orange method maintaining a relative advantage throughout.
